sources.citation: Seshat Global History Databank (2026). Cliopatria: a comprehensive geospatial dataset of world polities, version 0.2.0 (released 16 May 2026), cliopatria.geojson. CC BY 4.0. Changes made here: polygons for the Roman polities and their neighbours were extracted for 17 snapshot years, simplified with mapshaper 0.7.69 (Visvalingam, 25% of vertices kept), rounded to 0.01 degrees, and given shortened, translated labels.
Bennett, James S., Mutch, Erin, Tollefson, Andrew, Chalstrey, Ed, et al. (2025). "Cliopatria: a geospatial database of world-wide political entities from 3400 BCE to 2024 CE." Scientific Data 12.
Seshat Global History Databank. Cliopatria releases on Zenodo (concept record 13363121).
